steps.caption: Open Outreach, then the Messages tab.
Open the draft to Arjun Nair at Quokka Grid Infotech.
This is the draft. You can edit the text yourself at any time.
Why now: the reason for writing, the value for them and key facts like lease dates.
Rewrite with AI: each chip changes the draft in one way.
Now More formal. Each rewrite is saved as a new version.
Language and Translate rewrite it in Hinglish or Hindi.
Other ways to say it: Show 3 versions writes complete alternatives.
Concise, value-led and question-led. 'Use this one' would make it the draft.
Versions lists every one, newest first, marked Current.
Open the first draft to read it.
Prefer it? Use this version — it comes back as a new version, so nothing is lost.
The restored text is back in the draft, ready to approve.
